integrity: The counterexample is proved analytically from graph-state stabilizers. The bundled checker independently reconstructs all one- and two-qubit reduced spectra with exact rational arithmetic and was replayed from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns only the arithmetic aggregate built from the mutual-information probe in Eqs. (11)--(12) of arXiv:quant-ph/0603102.
It does not address the quasi-concurrence probe, the geometric aggregate, later total-correlation constructions, or the globally optimal four-qubit LOCC increase.
The literature comparison cannot exclude an obscure or poorly indexed note containing the same explicit cluster-state witness.
title: An endpoint cluster measurement increases a proposed pairwise mutual-information entanglement quantity
